name: Veedramon
main_effect: [When Digivolving] Reveal the top 4 cards of your deck. Add 1 yellow card with [Dramon] in its name and 1 card with the [Four Great Dragons] trait among them to your hand. Place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order.
source_effect: [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When you play a Digimon with the [Four Great Dragons] trait, 1 of those Digimon gains ＜Rush＞ for the turn. (This Digimon can attack the turn it comes into play.)
